name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
preparation: Melt butter, soften onion and garlic; add mushrooms and cook until browned.
Sprinkle maida, stir 1 minute; add stock gradually, simmer 10 minutes.
Blend half the soup for body, return to pan.
Add milk, cream, thyme, salt and pepper; warm through.

name: Broccoli Almond Soup
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli (florets and tender stems, chopped)
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in butter.
Add broccoli, almonds and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth; return, add milk and cream.
Season and serve with toasted almond flakes.

name: Roasted Tomato and Red Pepper Soup
preparation: Roast tomatoes, capsicum, onion and garlic with oil at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Squeeze garlic from skins; blend all with stock until smooth.
Simmer 5 minutes with sugar, basil, salt and pepper.
Swirl in cream to serve.

name: French Onion Soup (vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 cup grated gruyère or cheddar (vegetarian rennet)
preparation: Cook onions in butter and oil on low with sugar for 30 minutes, stirring, until deeply caramelised.
Stir in maida; add stock, thyme and balsamic; simmer 15 minutes; season.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, float a toast on each, pile on cheese.
Grill until the cheese bubbles and browns.

name: Pumpkin Soup
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in butter.
Add pumpkin and stock; simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend smooth, season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Serve with a swirl of cream and pumpkin seeds.

name: Herbed Potato Wedges
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes (cut into wedges, skin on)
preparation: Toss wedges with oil, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Spread on a tray, bake at 220°C for 30–35 minutes, turning once.
Sprinkle parmesan while hot; serve with a dip.

name: Crispy Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 cup chilled sparkling water or plain water
preparation: Whisk maida, cornflour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and water into a batter.
Dip rings in batter, then breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp; drain.

name: Corn and Cheese Balls
ingredients: ½ cup maida mixed with ½ cup water (slurry)
preparation: Mix corn, potato, cheese, 2 tbsp maida, chillies, coriander, salt and pepper; shape into balls.
Dip in slurry, roll in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry on medium until golden.

name: Hash Browns
preparation: Mix potato, onion, cornflour, salt and pepper.
Press into patties.
Pan-fry in butter on medium 5–6 minutes each side until golden and crisp.

name: Grilled Vegetable Skewers
preparation: Whisk oil, garlic, oregano, paprika, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toss vegetables and paneer in the marinade 15 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear 10–12 minutes, turning.

name: Loaded Potato Skins
ingredients: ½ cup sour cream or thick curd
preparation: Bake potatoes at 200°C for 45 minutes; halve and scoop out most of the flesh (save for mash).
Brush skins with oil, season, bake 10 minutes until crisp.
Fill with cheese and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream, spring onion and paprika.

name: Vegetable Cutlets
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, beans — boiled and mashed)
½ cup maida mixed with ½ cup water (slurry)
preparation: Mix mashed potato and vegetables with onion, chillies, ginger, pepper, cornflour and salt.
Shape into oval cutlets.
Dip in slurry, coat in breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry until golden on both sides.

name: Sweet Corn Fritters
preparation: Pulse half the corn coarsely; mix with whole kernels, flours, baking powder, milk, spring onion, chilli, salt and pepper.
Drop spoonfuls into a hot oiled pan.
Cook 2–3 minutes each side until golden.

name: Vegetable Au Gratin
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables (cauliflower, carrot, beans, peas, corn — blanched)
preparation: Melt butter, whisk in maida, add milk gradually; cook to a thick white sauce.
Stir in half the cheese, mustard, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fold in vegetables, pour into a dish, top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Mac and Cheese
preparation: Boil macaroni al dente; drain.
Melt butter, whisk in maida, add milk gradually to a smooth sauce; stir in cheeses, mustard, paprika, salt and pepper.
Fold in pasta, transfer to a dish, top with breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until bubbling.

name: Vegetable Shepherd's Pie
preparation: Mash potatoes with butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Sauté onion, garlic, carrot and mushrooms in oil; add lentils, peas, tomatoes, tomato paste, thyme and stock; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Spread filling in a dish, top with mash, fork the surface, scatter cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or fresh cream
preparation: Brown mushrooms in butter in batches; set aside.
Soften onion and garlic; add paprika and maida, stir 1 minute.
Add stock, tomato paste and mustard; simmer 5 minutes.
Return mushrooms, stir in cream, warm through gently; season and top with parsley. Serve with rice or pasta.

name: Spinach and Corn Bake
preparation: Make a white sauce with butter, maida and milk; season with garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fold in spinach, corn and half the cheeses.
Transfer to a dish, top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Cottage Cheese Steak with Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups sautéed vegetables (beans, carrot, broccoli) to serve
preparation: Rub paneer with oil, herbs and salt; sear on a hot pan 2 minutes each side.
Melt butter, soften onion and garlic; add crushed pepper and maida, stir 1 minute.
Add stock, simmer 3 minutes; stir in cream, season.
Pour sauce over paneer steaks; serve with sautéed vegetables and mash.

name: Grilled Cottage Cheese with Herb Butter
preparation: Mash butter with garlic, parsley, basil, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Brush paneer with oil, season, grill 2–3 minutes each side.
Top each slice with a spoon of herb butter so it melts over; serve with roasted vegetables.

name: Ratatouille
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil; add crushed tomatoes, thyme, salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes and spread in a baking dish.
Arrange alternating vegetable slices tightly over the sauce in a spiral.
Drizzle remaining oil, sprinkle basil and salt.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C for 35 minutes; uncover for 10 more.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Crêpes
preparation: Whisk maida, milk, melted butter and salt into a thin batter; rest 15 minutes. Cook thin crêpes on a lightly buttered pan.
Sauté mushrooms and garlic in butter until dry; add spinach until wilted; stir in cream, half the cheese, salt and pepper.
Fill crêpes, roll, place in a dish, scatter remaining cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 10 minutes.

name: Vegetable Pot Pie
preparation: Soften onion, garlic and carrot in butter; add mushrooms, peas and corn.
Stir in maida, then stock and milk; simmer to a thick creamy filling; add thyme, salt and pepper.
Fill a pie dish, cover with pastry, crimp edges, cut a vent, brush with milk.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
ingredients: 4 large zucchini (halved, centres scooped and chopped)
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic and chopped zucchini flesh in oil; add tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper; cook 5 minutes.
Mix in quinoa and half the mozzarella.
Fill boats, top with remaining cheeses.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Cheese
preparation: Make a white sauce with butter, maida and milk; add 1 cup cheese, mustard, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Arrange cauliflower in a dish and pour the sauce over.
Top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta Bake
preparation: Boil pasta al dente; drain.
Brown mushrooms and garlic in butter; stir in maida, then milk gradually for a smooth sauce.
Add cheddar, thyme, salt and pepper; fold in pasta.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.

name: Herb Butter Rice
preparation: Rinse rice; cook with water and salt until fluffy.
Melt butter, soften garlic 1 minute.
Fold garlic butter, herbs and lemon zest through the hot rice.

name: Mushroom Rice Pilaf
preparation: Brown mushrooms in butter; add onion and garlic, soften.
Add rice, toast 1 minute; add stock, thyme, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes; rest 5, fluff with parsley.

name: Baked Vegetable Rice
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (capsicum, corn, peas, carrot)
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add vegetables and rice, stir 2 minutes.
Add stock, oregano, salt and pepper; transfer to a baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.
Uncover, scatter cheese, bake 8 minutes more.

name: Lemon Herb Couscous
preparation: Pour hot stock over couscous with 1 tbsp oil; cover 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Stir in remaining oil, lemon juice, zest, herbs, tomatoes, salt and pepper.

name: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
preparation: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender; drain and mash.
Soften garlic in butter 2 minutes.
Beat garlic butter, warm milk, cream, salt and pepper into the potatoes until smooth.

name: Rosemary Roast Potatoes
preparation: Parboil potatoes 8 minutes; drain and shake to rough up the edges.
Toss with oil, rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper on a hot tray.
Roast at 220°C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

name: Creamy Polenta
preparation: Bring stock to a boil; whisk in polenta.
Cook on low, stirring often, 20 minutes until thick and smooth.
Beat in butter, parmesan, milk, salt and pepper.

name: Buttered Noodles with Parmesan
preparation: Boil noodles al dente; reserve ¼ cup water; drain.
Toss with butter, parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Season and finish with parsley.

name: Sautéed Garlic Green Beans
preparation: Blanch beans 3 minutes in salted water; drain.
Heat butter and oil, cook garlic until pale gold.
Toss beans through 2 minutes; add lemon juice, salt, pepper and almonds.

name: Honey-glazed Carrots
preparation: Simmer carrots with water, butter and salt, covered, 8 minutes.
Uncover, add honey and thyme, cook until the liquid reduces to a glaze.
Season with pepper.

name: Creamed Spinach
preparation: Wilt spinach in a dry pan; squeeze out excess water.
Soften onion and garlic in butter; stir in maida, then milk and cream.
Add spinach, nutmeg, parmesan, salt and pepper; simmer 3 minutes.

name: Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
preparation: Toss all vegetables with oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Roast in a single layer at 210°C for 30–35 minutes, turning once.
Drizzle balsamic before serving.

name: Cheese Garlic Bread
preparation: Mix butter, garlic, parsley and salt; spread on bread.
Top with both cheeses, oregano and chilli flakes.
Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until melted and golden.

name: Soft Dinner Rolls
preparation: Mix maida, yeast, sugar, salt, warm milk and 3 tbsp butter; knead 8 minutes; rest 1 hour until doubled.
Divide into 12 balls, arrange in a greased tray, rest 30 minutes.
Brush with milk, bake at 190°C for 18–20 minutes; brush with remaining butter.

name: Herbed Flatbread
preparation: Mix maida, baking powder, salt, curd, water and 1 tbsp oil into a soft dough; rest 30 minutes.
Roll into ovals, brush with garlic oil and herbs.
Cook on a hot pan 2 minutes each side until puffed and spotted.

name: Coleslaw
preparation: Whisk mayonnaise, curd, lemon juice, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Toss cabbage, carrot and onion in the dressing.
Chill 30 minutes before serving.

name: Garden Salad with Vinaigrette
preparation: Whisk oil, vinegar, mustard, honey, salt and pepper into a vinaigrette.
Toss leaves and vegetables with the dressing just before serving.

name: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
preparation: Cook mushrooms and garlic in butter until dry and browned.
Stir in maida; add stock, simmer 3 minutes.
Add cream, thyme, salt and pepper; simmer to a coating consistency. Serve over paneer steak or mash.

name: Cheese Sauce
preparation: Melt butter, whisk in maida, cook 1 minute.
Add milk gradually, whisking, until thick.
Off heat, stir in cheese, mustard, nutmeg, salt and pepper.

name: Apple Crumble
preparation: Toss apples with sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice; spread in a dish.
Rub butter into maida, oats, brown sugar and salt until crumbly.
Scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until golden; serve warm with ice cream or custard.

name: Eggless Chocolate Mousse
preparation: Melt chocolate with ½ cup cream; cool to room temperature.
Whip remaining cream with icing sugar, vanilla and salt to soft peaks.
Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate in three additions.
Spoon into glasses, chill 2 hours, top with shaved chocolate.

name: Eggless Bread and Butter Pudding
preparation: Arrange buttered bread overlapping in a dish, scattering raisins between.
Whisk milk, cream, sugar, cornflour, vanilla and cinnamon; pour over the bread and rest 15 minutes.
Sprinkle brown sugar.
Bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until set and golden.

name: Eggless Baked Cheesecake
preparation: Mix biscuits and butter, press into a lined tin, chill.
Beat cream cheese and sugar smooth; add cream, cornflour, lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour over the base; bake at 160°C for 45–50 minutes until just set with a slight wobble.
Cool, chill 4 hours, serve with compote.

name: Cold Coffee
preparation: Blend milk, coffee, sugar, ice cream and ice until frothy.
Pour into tall glasses, dust with cocoa.
